camera.placementNote: Held by a person sitting opposite the subject at a restaurant booth.

setting.lighting: Dim ambient restaurant lighting with a harsh direct light (likely phone flash) illuminating the subject.
setting.colorPalette: Warm browns, bright orange (wings), stark white (flash on skin).

lines.text: Alright yeah, uh, I'm gonna get the check.

whyItWorks.mechanism: Subversion of expectations. The text sets up a romantic/dating context, while the visual delivers feral, unladylike behavior.
retentionDrivers: Shock value of the aggressive eating.
Anticipation of the off-camera person's reaction.
The comedic climax of the eye-roll bite.
whyItWorks.targetViewer: Young adults, dating app users, fans of cringe/awkward comedy.
whyItWorks.shareCommentTrigger: Relatability to bad dates, or tagging friends who eat like this.

workarounds: Can be filmed at any dining table with messy food.

mustKeep: The text overlay establishing a 'first date' context.
The third-person POV from across a table.
The contrast between a dressed-up subject and messy, aggressive eating.
swappable: The specific food (could be ribs, a massive burger, spaghetti).
The exact location (could be a fancy restaurant or a fast food joint).
The specific outfit, as long as it looks like date attire.

triggers: Suggestive facial expression (eyes rolling back) while eating
